goal: Support needs to record refunds without touching the database. Add a `refund ORDER_ID` command that marks a paid order as refunded and confirms with `refunded <order id> (<amount>)`, the amount shown the way the tool shows money for that merchant. Only paid orders can be refunded: refunding a refunded or cancelled order is an error and must change nothing. An order id we don't have should be reported the same way an unknown customer is (`error: unknown order <id>`). After a refund the daily report should show the order under Refunded instead of in the total.
